segments.HOS.1.1-2: The LORD tells Hosea to marry a prostitute
segments.HOS.1.3-5: Hosea and Gomer have a son named Jezreel
segments.HOS.1.10-11: God promises that Israel will become many and united
segments.HOS.2.1-1: Israel’s brothers and sisters are called God’s people
segments.HOS.2.2-3: God warns unfaithful Israel, like a wife, of punishment
segments.HOS.2.4-5: God will not pity the children of the unfaithful mother
segments.HOS.2.6-7: God will block Israel from chasing false gods
segments.HOS.2.8-9: God will take back the gifts Israel used for Baal
segments.HOS.2.10-11: God will end Israel’s feasts and expose her sin
segments.HOS.2.12-13: God will punish Israel for worshiping Baals
segments.HOS.2.14-15: God will win Israel back in the wilderness
segments.HOS.2.16-17: Israel will call God her Husband, not Master
segments.HOS.2.18-18: God will make a covenant and bring peace and safety
segments.HOS.2.19-20: God promises to marry Israel forever in faithfulness
segments.HOS.2.21-22: God will bless the land with grain, wine and oil
segments.HOS.2.23-23: God will show mercy and call Israel his people
segments.HOS.3.1-3: Hosea loves his wife again and buys her back
segments.HOS.3.4-5: Israel will be without a king, then return to the LORD
segments.HOS.4.1-2: The LORD accuses Israel of lying, murder and stealing
segments.HOS.4.3-3: The land mourns and living things waste away
segments.HOS.4.4-5: God warns that priest and prophet will stumble
segments.HOS.4.6-7: God’s people are destroyed for lack of knowledge
segments.HOS.4.8-9: God will punish both priests and people for sin
segments.HOS.4.10-10: Israel will eat but not be satisfied
segments.HOS.4.11-12: Wine and idols take away Israel’s understanding
segments.HOS.4.13-14: Israel’s idol worship and prostitution bring ruin
segments.HOS.4.15-16: God warns Judah not to follow Israel’s sin
segments.HOS.4.17-19: Ephraim is joined to idols and will be ashamed
segments.HOS.5.1-2: God judges the priests and royal house of Israel
segments.HOS.5.3-4: God knows Ephraim has turned to prostitution
segments.HOS.5.5-7: Israel and Judah stumble and cannot find the LORD
segments.HOS.5.8-9: A trumpet warns that Ephraim will be laid waste
segments.HOS.5.10-11: God’s anger falls on Judah’s princes and on Ephraim
segments.HOS.5.14-15: God will punish Ephraim and Judah like a lion
segments.HOS.6.1-3: The people urge each other to return to the LORD
segments.HOS.6.6-7: God wants mercy, not sacrifice, from Israel
segments.HOS.6.8-9: Gilead’s evildoers and priests commit murder
segments.HOS.6.10-11: God sees Israel’s sin and promises a harvest for Judah
segments.HOS.7.1-2: God will expose the evil of Ephraim and Samaria
segments.HOS.7.3-5: Israel’s leaders please the king with evil and lies
segments.HOS.7.6-7: Israel’s kings fall and no one calls on God
segments.HOS.7.8-9: Ephraim mixes with the nations and loses strength
segments.HOS.7.10-11: Ephraim seeks help from Egypt and Assyria, not God
segments.HOS.7.12-13: God will punish Israel for straying and lying
segments.HOS.7.14-15: Israel does not cry to God from the heart
segments.HOS.7.16-16: Israel is like a faulty bow and leaders will fall
segments.HOS.8.1-3: An enemy will attack because Israel broke God’s covenant
segments.HOS.8.4-5: Israel chose its own kings and made idols
segments.HOS.8.6-7: Samaria’s calf idol will break; Israel reaps a whirlwind
segments.HOS.8.8-10: Israel pays Assyria for help and will be punished
segments.HOS.8.11-12: Ephraim builds altars for sin and ignores God’s law
segments.HOS.8.13-14: God rejects Israel’s sacrifices and will send fire
segments.HOS.9.1-2: God warns Israel not to rejoice after being unfaithful
segments.HOS.9.3-4: Israel will leave the land for Egypt and Assyria
segments.HOS.9.5-6: Israel’s people will die in Egypt and thorns will grow
segments.HOS.9.7-7: The days of punishment come because of Israel’s sin
segments.HOS.9.8-9: Israel is as corrupt as in the days of Gibeah
segments.HOS.9.10-10: God found Israel like grapes, but Israel worshiped Baal-peor
segments.HOS.9.11-12: God will take away Ephraim’s children and glory
segments.HOS.9.13-14: Ephraim’s children will be killed and wombs will fail
segments.HOS.9.15-15: God will drive Israel out because of evil at Gilgal
segments.HOS.9.16-17: God rejects Ephraim, who will wander among the nations
segments.HOS.10.1-2: God will destroy the altars Israel built in good times
segments.HOS.10.3-4: Israel says it has no king and makes false oaths
segments.HOS.10.5-6: Samaria’s people will mourn when the calf idol is taken
segments.HOS.10.7-8: Samaria and her king will be swept away
segments.HOS.10.9-9: Israel has sinned since the days of Gibeah
segments.HOS.10.10-11: God will bring nations to punish Israel’s double sin
segments.HOS.10.12-13: Israel is told to sow righteousness and seek the LORD
segments.HOS.10.14-15: War will destroy Israel’s fortresses and end its king
segments.HOS.11.1-2: God loved Israel as a child, but Israel turned to Baals
segments.HOS.11.3-4: God taught Ephraim to walk and led Ephraim with love
segments.HOS.11.5-7: Israel refused to repent, so Assyria will rule Israel
segments.HOS.11.8-9: God’s compassion keeps him from destroying Israel
segments.HOS.11.10-11: God will bring his children home from Egypt and Assyria
segments.HOS.11.12-12: Ephraim is full of lies, but Judah stays faithful to God
segments.HOS.12.1-2: Ephraim makes treaties, and God accuses Judah
segments.HOS.12.3-4: Jacob struggled with God and found him at Bethel
segments.HOS.12.5-6: Israel must return to God and keep love and justice
segments.HOS.12.7-8: Ephraim boasts of wealth and cheats with false scales
segments.HOS.12.9-10: God spoke to Israel through the prophets
segments.HOS.12.13-14: God brought Israel out by a prophet; Ephraim angered God
segments.HOS.13.1-2: Ephraim sinned with Baal and made idols of silver
segments.HOS.13.3-3: Israel will vanish like mist, dew, chaff and smoke
segments.HOS.13.4-6: God is the only Savior, but Israel forgot God
segments.HOS.13.7-8: God will attack Israel like a lion, leopard and bear
segments.HOS.13.9-11: Israel is destroyed because Israel turned against God
segments.HOS.13.12-13: Ephraim’s sin is stored up, and Ephraim is unwise
segments.HOS.13.14-14: God speaks of redeeming Israel from death and Sheol
segments.HOS.13.15-15: A wind from the LORD will dry up Israel’s springs
segments.HOS.13.16-16: Samaria will fall by the sword for rebelling against God
segments.HOS.14.1-2: Israel is called to return to the LORD and pray
segments.HOS.14.3-3: Israel promises to trust God, not Assyria or idols
segments.HOS.14.4-6: God promises to heal and love Israel freely
segments.HOS.14.7-8: Israel will grow again, and God will care for Ephraim
segments.HOS.14.9-9: The wise understand that the LORD’s ways are right
